title: In Your presence

lines.text: In the cleft of the Rock
I want to go where the rivers
Where my feet are on the rock
I want to hide where the blazing fire
I want to hide where the flood of
Where I'm covered by the blood
I want to be where the schemes of darkness

chords:
[Verse 1]
In Your presence
That's where I am strong
In Your presence
O Lord my God
In Your presence
That's where I belong
Seeking Your face
Touching Your grace
In the cleft of the Rock
In Your presence O God

[Verse 2]
I want to go where the rivers
Cannot overflow me
Where my feet are on the rock
I want to hide where the blazing fire
Cannot burn me
In Your presence O God

[Verse 3]
I want to hide where the flood of
Evil cannot reach me
Where I'm covered by the blood
I want to be where the schemes of darkness
Cannot touch me
In Your presence O God
